title: Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released **Claude Fable 5** alongside **Claude Mythos 5** — the first public launch of a model from Anthropic's new "Mythos-class" tier, which sits above the Opus tier in the capability hierarchy. Fable 5 is described as the most capable model Anthropic has ever made generally available.

---

## Model Tiers Explained

With this release, Anthropic's model family now has four tiers:

| Tier | Example | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| Haiku | Haiku 4.5 | Fastest, lowest cost |
| Sonnet | Sonnet 4.6 | Balanced capability/cost |
| Opus | Opus 4.8 | High-capability workhorse |
| Mythos | Fable 5 / Mythos 5 | Frontier-class, highest capability |

**Mythos 5** is the internal research-grade model. **Fable 5** is a safety-reviewed derivative of Mythos 5 cleared for general API access — Anthropic considers it nearly equivalent for most tasks (95%+ of Fable sessions involve no fallback to Opus 4.8).

---

## Benchmark Performance

Fable 5 represents a substantial jump over Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks:

- **FrontierCode (Diamond split):** 29.3% — more than double Opus 4.8's 13.4%, and well ahead of GPT-5.5's 5.7%
- **SWE-Bench Pro:** 80.3% — approximately 11 points ahead of the next-best frontier model
- **Slay the Spire (agentic game benchmark):** With persistent file-based memory, Fable 5 improved 3× more than Opus 4.8 on performance and reached the final act 3× as often — a proxy for long-horizon planning and state management

---

## Safety Architecture

Fable 5's general availability is enabled by a **fallback safety system**: when Fable's classifiers detect requests in high-risk categories, the request is automatically rerouted to Claude Opus 4.8 instead. Users are informed when this occurs. Affected categories include:

- Cybersecurity attack assistance
- Biology and chemistry (dual-use research)
- LLM distillation (training other frontier models)

For the distillation safeguard specifically, the intervention is silent — responses are degraded via prompt modification, steering vectors, or parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) rather than a visible fallback.

---

## Availability

At launch (June 9, 2026), Fable 5 is available via:

- Anthropic API (model ID: `claude-fable-5`)
- Claude.ai (Max, Team, and Enterprise plans)
- GitHub Copilot (generally available)
- Databricks (via Unity AI Gateway)

---

## Context and Implications

Fable 5 breaks Anthropic's previous practice of keeping Mythos-class capability behind an access-restricted program. The safety fallback system is what makes broader availability possible — it provides a practical way to deploy frontier capability while limiting the highest-risk use cases. This approach may become the template for future frontier model releases.
